messages:
ash_support: Escalating to CS: MercuryDocs (trial) hitting intermittent 500s and rate-limit errors on embeddings during SSO/onboarding import. Customer says this blocks their pilot validation next week. Marked P1.

ash_support: Repro notes: bulk import ~3.5k docs via sync endpoint; failures begin ~45s in. Observed `HTTP 429` with retry storms and `HTTP 500 {\"error\":\"internal_server_error\"}`. No code deploys in past 48h.

riley_cs: Thanks — primary contact is diane@mercurydocs.com, pilot kickoff 2026-04-08. Renewal touchpoint planned Q2. This looks like a conversion risk. Recommend short-term comms + bridge and an offer for a concierge run if we need to finish the import.

noah_csm: Agreed. We should position comms to reassure + offer remediation steps and a one-time help-run. Keep tone apologetic but confident.

ivy_eng: Quick look at logs: gateway token bucket exhausted then router OOM traces. Likely client retry amplification + large batch sizes causing KV-cache churn. Quick mitigations: advise async batch + reduce concurrency; possible tenant quota mismatch. I can run a tenant audit and a staging repro. ETA 3h for audit, 6h for validate patch.

deploy-bot: last deploy for embed-service v2.16.0 completed 2026-03-18T03:22:10Z by @ivy_eng. No recent config flips.

ops-bot: alert: tenant_errors(mercurydocs) > 4% over 5m at 2026-03-25T09:12Z. Will page if >8% sustained. Temporary autoscaler headroom recommendation: +20%.

ash_support: Draft customer message for Diane: "Hi Diane — were investigating intermittent errors affecting your import. Short-term workaround: switch to the async batch endpoint and limit client concurrency to 2; we can also apply a one-time quota uplift so your import completes. Engineering will provide an update within 4 hours and an RCA within 72 hours. We'll join a bridge to walk through steps." Thoughts?

riley_cs: That reads well. Add: include exact CLI snippet and offer to run the import for them if they'd like (concierge support). Also schedule a 20-min bridge within 2 hours.

ash_support: Adding CLI snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/async -d @batch.json -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\" --concurrency 2` and suggest exponential backoff with jitter.

ivy_eng: Doing tenant quota audit now. If legacy trial quota is low we can apply a temporary bump (24h) and monitor. I'll also try `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.75` in staging to see if that reduces OOMs.

noah_csm: Customer angle: offer one-week trial extension or concierge run if they want reassurance before the pilot. I'll prepare the renewal-protection note for account record.

ops-bot: action: applying temporary tenant_quota=300 to tenant=mercurydocs at 2026-03-25T09:25Z (24h) by ops-bot (per eng request). Manual headroom +20% enabled on embed-pool.

ivy_eng: Staging canary started. Initial repro shows KV-cache churn; `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.75` reduced OOMs by ~88% in tests. Preparing canary rollout plan. ETA 6-8h for safe prod canary if we get green.

riley_cs: I scheduled a 20-min bridge with Diane for 2026-03-25 10:00 PT. Invited @noah_csm, @ivy_eng, @ash_support. I'll send the pre-brief and the CLI snippet now.

ash_support: Action items recap: (1) send customer note + CLI snippet + offer concierge (riley_cs) due now; (2) eng audit + staging validation (ivy_eng) ETA 6-8h; (3) ops temp quota + headroom (ops-bot) applied; (4) RCA + long-term remediation plan (ivy_eng) due 72h.

noah_csm: After bridge: Diane appreciated quick action and accepted the temporary uplift. She asked for a written runbook and assurance before the pilot. I offered the concierge import and a post-fix check-in on 2026-03-27 09:00 PT.

ivy_eng: Prod canary plan: small percentage of nodes with `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.75` + gateway smoothing knob for tenant. Will coordinate with ops for 6h window and rollback conditions (error rate >2% sustained).

ops-bot: monitoring: will auto-revert manual headroom when tenant_errors(mercurydocs) < 1% for 30m. Paging enabled if >5% sustained.

noah_csm: Thanks team. Ill log renewal-risk and the mitigation steps in the CRM and prepare a short executive note after we have the RCA. Keep updates concise on this thread so I can forward.

ash_support: Update 2026-03-25T11:15Z  Diane confirms import completed to 95% after applying our guidance and the temporary quota. Customer accepted concierge offer for the remainder and requested the RCA prior to pilot kickoff.

riley_cs: I'll follow up with Diane and attach the runbook + post-mitigation check-in invite. Great cross-team response.

ivy_eng: Will post a short RCA and proposed long-term fixes (trial quota defaults, onboarding guardrails, telemetry for retry storms) in this thread within 72h.

noah_csm: Closing note: please keep final RCA bulletized and include proposed customer-facing wording so we can attach to renewal communications.
